outline: 能源工程主要為介紹現有能源供應系統包含熱能及電能，上課的內容為包含熱流原理導論及再生能源、傳統火力電廠與汽電共生系統的系統原理介紹。
schedule:
Introduction
Review of thermodynamics
Material and Energy balance
Energy and energy types
Mechanical energy and electrical energy
Internal energy and enthalpy
Fuels and combustion
Energy conversion
Thermodynamic cycles
Focused topic: Steam turbine and Rankine cycle
Focused topic: Gas turbine and Brayton cycle
Focused topic: Combined cycle and cogeneration
Advanced systems
Energy storage
Energy conservation
Alternative systems
Fuel cells, Magnetohydrodynamic energy conversion
